attributes.action: Stop state control of online news feeds and smart TV menus
attributes.additional_details: We call on the Government to abandon plans legally to compel smart TVs and social media platforms to algorithmically prioritise state-approved media over independent competitors, and to preserve traditional aerial TV indefinitely as a vital national fail-safe. Using secondary legislation or Statutory Instruments to implement these sweeping algorithmic changes bypasses democratic scrutiny, avoids a Commons vote, and undermines the public's right to choose their own news.
attributes.background: Require any government-led streaming prominence regimes or changes to digital broadcasting to be enacted solely via a standalone Act of Parliament. Prevent the DCMS from implementing algorithm manipulation or phasing out aerial TV via secondary legislation.

rejection.details: You may wish to sign this petition, which calls for similar action: "Do not require online platforms to promote selected media organisations" https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/776161
